units.id: mission:Avgi Culture: Dissonance Graffiti 1|Colorful, curvy symbols are scrawled all across the walls, floor, and ceiling of <planet>'s spaceport terminal, and you can see a handful of Avgi with brushes and mops attempting to remove them.
